You Are What You Eat

Sep 12, 2007 • Janice Cotcher

Parents warned of additives link
Parents have been warned of the effects of food additives on their children’s behaviour after new research found a possible link to hyperactivity. (Last Updated: Thursday, 6 September 2007, 07:41 GMT 08:41 UK)

Hyper Kids? Cut Out Preservatives
Thursday, Sept. 06, 2007 By CLAUDIA WALLIS

These studies remind me of a student who became extremely hyper when she consumed red food dye. The preschool could control what she ate at school but the mother let her daughter eat whatever she wanted. The kicked the little girl out because the mother refused to control her daughter’s diet. Good for them! Don’t believe in the connection between diet and behaviour? Spend a day in a grade 1 class.
